feature_flag: live Linear collection and scheduled registration remain separately bound/default-OFF; activation requires the private binding, the Owner-placed API key file, and the registrar dry-run/register sequence
authority_notes: Read-only Linear collection lane (HPP, every 15 minutes) that publishes the refs-only run receipt contract consumed by the path_registry Linear source-lane adapter and emits official_task_read_evidence-compatible envelopes for Forge/ERP admission. It sends only GraphQL query documents, never a mutation, and owns no Linear writer, task writer, backup generation, restore, or acceptance authority. The API key is read only through the private binding's credentials (api_key_env, then the fenced api_key_file) using the Slack lane's credential boundary rule and is never logged, persisted, or returned. Collection is not backup: LB1 backup generations remain owned by backup_controller.
